### Changed
- **Runs think at pi's default level, medium** (#66, added in #NN). pi-action now sets a thinking level on every run, with the new `thinking_level` input (`off`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`). Before, every run was `off`. Runs on models with reasoning can now use more tokens and time.
